purpose: Test whether the finite-shot long-range-observable advantage attributed to MERA survives explicit parameter and gate matching.

MERA_PM225.role: parameter-matched MERA using preregistered within-layer sharing

MPS.role: canonical chi=2 sequential MPS analysis circuit

BRICKWORK390.role: gate-and-coordinate-matched nearest-neighbour local control for full MERA

primary_contrasts.name: parameter_matched_mera_vs_mps
primary_contrasts.interpretation: same 225 independent coordinates; MERA uses more physical blocks

primary_contrasts.name: gate_and_parameter_matched_mera_vs_local
primary_contrasts.interpretation: same 26 physical blocks and 390 independent coordinates; compares multiscale and local brickwork geometry

statistics.bootstrap_interval: paired percentile bootstrap with 20000 resamples, reported as sensitivity analysis

decision_rules.parameter_matched_long_range_support: MERA_PM225 minus MPS mean zz_long_range_mae is negative and its paired 95 percent t interval excludes zero.
decision_rules.gate_matched_geometry_support: MERA minus BRICKWORK390 mean zz_long_range_mae is negative and its paired 95 percent t interval excludes zero.
decision_rules.strongest_allowed_claim: A MERA geometry advantage is supported only if both primary long-range rules pass. Fidelity, energy, and entropy must still be reported even when they disagree.
decision_rules.failure_rule: Any failed primary rule is reported as-is. No hyperparameter, architecture, field, or replicate may be changed after pilot results are inspected.

seed_policy.description: All architectures in a field-replicate cell use the same initialization, SPSA-direction, and measurement seed labels. Equal-coordinate models receive exactly the same initial vector.

guardrails: The pilot replicates 50-52 are exploratory and are not included in the full confirmatory replicates 60-69.
BRICKWORK390 is not called an MPS because adding trainable layers changes the canonical chi=2 MPS family.
MERA_PM225 versus MPS is parameter matched but not physical-gate matched.
MERA versus BRICKWORK390 is gate and coordinate matched but is not a direct canonical-MPS comparison.
Fields 0.9, 1.0, and 1.1 have appeared in earlier diagnostics, so this is a controlled mechanism study rather than untouched-field confirmation.
No pilot result may be used to change the frozen full-study protocol.
